correctness.rationale: The finite domain is completely enumerated. Unique RREF enumeration gives all \(788035\) six-subspaces and \(43435\) seven-subspaces of \(\mathbb F_2^9\). The triangularizability test is equivalent to characteristic-polynomial splitting and uses exactly the four split monic cubics of degree three over \(\mathbb F_2\). A second codimension-three orthogonal-complement enumeration returns the same \(35\) six-spaces. Exact \(\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathbb F_2)\) conjugation partitions them into disjoint orbits of sizes \(21\), \(7\), and \(7\). The three model spaces are also checked directly from their block forms.
